extraction.quote_span: The creek crossings were knee high at 8am

detail.quote: The creek crossings were knee high at 8am
detail.text: Exited via Taboose on 7/9. Upper basin has patchy snow you can mostly avoid, then the endless dry descent. My knees filed a complaint. The creek crossings were knee high at 8am and I would not want them at 4pm. First time on this trail and it is no joke.

detail.author: OldGoatKen

extraction.quote_span: Taboose Creek is running strong at the second crossing, knee high early

detail.quote: Taboose Creek is running strong at the second crossing, knee high early
detail.text: Taboose Pass 7/6. The east approach is snow free and as brutal as ever, 6000 feet of loose everything. Upper bowl holds patchy snow, firm at dawn, no traction needed if you pick your line. Taboose Creek is running strong at the second crossing, knee high early, higher by noon.
